global.layout: Editorial cut-paper collage with varied crop sizes, deliberate negative space, and brand-specific shapes. Do not default to repeated bean shapes or a rigid product grid.
global.context: Use an interior, street, landscape, or prop only when it supports the brand. A setting is optional, not mandatory.
global.casting: Use no more than two images of the same person. Match the brand's womenswear, menswear, or unisex range.
global.duplicate_policy: Every hero product, detail crop, person, pose, colourway, and setting must be visibly distinct.
global.text_policy: No accidental words, labels, captions, watermarks, or unrelated logos.
global.logo_policy: Use a distinctive brand mark only when the brand override explicitly asks for it. Keep it secondary to the products.

must_include: one recognisable branded long sleeve or scarf
clothes/acne_studios.context: Sparse urban or studio fragments with cool light and restrained texture.
clothes/acne_studios.layout: Angular cropped panels and narrow strips rather than rounded bean shapes.
clothes/acne_studios.logo_policy: One subtle Acne Studios identifier may appear on a garment. No large wordmark.

must_include: six or more visibly different products
a photographic or airbrushed shirt print
must_avoid: repeating the same red-and-black knitted figures
clothes/carne_bollente.context: Playful Paris studio and street fragments with candid unisex styling; products remain the focus.
clothes/carne_bollente.layout: Lively cut-paper editorial collage with clearly separated garments, varied scales, and no motif appearing more than once.
clothes/carne_bollente.duplicate_policy: Every tile must show a different garment and a different cheeky figurative treatment; no repeated character, pose, print, embroidery, colourway, or detail crop.
clothes/carne_bollente.logo_policy: Recognisability must come from varied cheeky figurative artwork rather than a wordmark. No readable slogans.

must_include: clean contemporary silhouettes with an eclectic material mix
one warped plaid or graphic-check silk dress
one saturated marigold, rose, or translucent-green piece
one sequin or paillette evening layer
one unexpected feather, mesh, fringe, or shoelace construction detail
at least one sharp layered look
clothes/chan_luu.context: Contemporary art-space, clean studio, or sharp city fragments with controlled colour and surprising textile detail.
clothes/chan_luu.layout: Eclectic editorial collage with crisp irregular panels, alternating restrained full looks with close material and print details; colour and texture should move across the page without becoming bohemian.
clothes/chan_luu.duplicate_policy: Every panel must introduce a different silhouette, material, print, colour family, or styling idea; do not repeat plain shirts, neutral knits, or near-identical minimal looks.
clothes/chan_luu.logo_policy: No wordmark is needed; recognisability comes from the tension between clean shapes and unusual print, shine, texture, and colour.

must_include: one atmospheric abstract or photographic print
a cropped or cape-layered tailored piece
fluid trousers or a batwing dress
Klein blue, plum, moss, rust, seafoam, or sand accents
must_avoid: multiple views of the same knit
clothes/christian_wijnants.context: Contemporary Antwerp studio or architectural gallery fragments with expressive colour and restrained texture.
clothes/christian_wijnants.layout: Modern asymmetric editorial collage alternating sculptural silhouettes, tactile knits, strong colour, and one expressive print.
clothes/christian_wijnants.duplicate_policy: Every panel must show a different garment family, silhouette, colour, and print or knit treatment.

must_include: a structured white high-neck poplin blouse
a camel checker top or trouser
a brown jacket with dark velvet detail
one burgundy or royal-blue sculptural piece
clothes/destree.context: Crisp gallery or Paris studio with graphic shadows and restrained architectural props.
clothes/destree.layout: Sharp geometric panels with controlled black, white, camel, burgundy, and cobalt colour blocking.
clothes/destree.duplicate_policy: Show six to eight distinct clothing silhouettes; no repeated black coat or neutral close-up.

must_include: a bomber, work jacket, or technical fleece
must_avoid: repeating the same star, planet, or cartoon print
clothes/dime.context: Montreal skate spot, concrete plaza, or clean street-product studio fragments.
clothes/dime.layout: Loose skate-editorial collage with solids doing most of the work and no graphic appearing twice.
clothes/dime.duplicate_policy: Every garment, graphic, colour, pose, and crop must be unique; use at most two printed hero pieces.

clothes/girlfriend_collective.context: Bright clean studio and minimal outdoor movement fragments; colour is the primary brand signal.
clothes/girlfriend_collective.layout: Energetic colour-block collage with distinct monochrome sets and varied activewear silhouettes.
clothes/girlfriend_collective.duplicate_policy: Each panel uses a different saturated colour and silhouette; do not repeat the same bra-and-legging pose.

must_include: a dress or skirt woven from multiple black leather belts
visible buckles and belt loops as construction
a white shirt reworked with belt straps
clothes/hodakova.context: Raw Stockholm studio, mannequin, or stark runway fragments that foreground converted materials.
clothes/hodakova.layout: Conceptual cut-paper collage with belts visibly functioning as garment structure, not accessories.
clothes/hodakova.duplicate_policy: Each panel must show a different reconstruction technique and garment type; no repeated outfit or bag.

clothes/homecore.context: Friendly Paris street, workshop, cafe, or colour-washed studio with natural candid posture.
clothes/homecore.layout: Warm human collage mixing full looks with distinct knit, shirt, jacket, jersey, and trouser details.
clothes/homecore.duplicate_policy: Use at least six different garments and four clearly different colours; no repeated neutral knit.

must_include: one textured jacket or coordinated set
bright green, butter, cherry, blue, and chocolate accents
must_avoid: repeating one swirl or brown-green print
clothes/house_of_sunny.context: Playful London studio and sunny street fragments with quirky styling and crafted texture.
clothes/house_of_sunny.layout: Colourful sticker-like collage led by six distinct knit and surface languages, not repeated detail crops.
clothes/house_of_sunny.duplicate_policy: Every knit, print, colour, silhouette, and model pose must be visibly different.

must_include: one confetti, stripe, mint, pink, or red accent
Mediterranean sensuality through proportion and light
clothes/jacquemus.context: Sun-cut architectural studio, Paris runway, or South-of-France exterior with strong graphic shadow.
clothes/jacquemus.layout: Sculptural high-fashion collage balancing black, dark brown, beige, off-white, denim, and one vivid accent.
clothes/jacquemus.duplicate_policy: Each panel must introduce a different silhouette and proportion; no repeated cream dress or fabric crop.

must_include: polished printed silk shirt or blouse
one velvet or mesh evening piece
one relaxed trouser or matching set
jewel, tobacco, navy, wine, and cream tones
clothes/johnny_was.context: Polished city, studio, and autumn garden editorial fragments rather than a holiday resort.
clothes/johnny_was.layout: Rich but controlled silk, embroidery, outerwear, trousers, and evening texture with one distinct print per panel.
clothes/johnny_was.duplicate_policy: No garment, floral family, model pose, or textile crop may repeat.

must_include: visible sculptural metal wire bra or frame construction
clothes/karoline_vitto.context: Clean London studio or runway where body, metal framing, colour, and drape carry the image.
clothes/karoline_vitto.layout: Sculptural close and full looks balanced across black, red, orange, cobalt, and pink.
clothes/karoline_vitto.duplicate_policy: Every panel must change colour, body silhouette, garment type, and metal-frame placement.

clothes/kowtow.context: Bright modernist Wellington studio, civic architecture, or natural daylight with crisp honest materials.
clothes/kowtow.layout: Spare graphic composition with visible garment construction, volume, stripe, denim, and one bright accent.
clothes/kowtow.duplicate_policy: Use at least six garment families and no repeated neutral silhouette.

clothes/laagam.context: Contemporary Barcelona street and clean product-studio fragments with youthful day-to-night styling.
clothes/laagam.layout: Modern European high-street collage mixing everyday separates, texture, denim, tailoring, and one playful accent.
clothes/laagam.duplicate_policy: Every panel must use a different garment family, texture, colour, and styling purpose.

must_include: pool blue, lemon, clover, pink, silver, and black accents
clothes/lioness.context: Clean Sydney street, studio, or nightlife fragments with confident contemporary styling.
clothes/lioness.layout: Trend-forward mix of denim, sporty outerwear, fitted tops, skirts, and one evening look rather than generic glamour.
clothes/lioness.duplicate_policy: No repeated dress, print, pose, or black tailoring silhouette.

must_include: brown, navy, tomato, moss, sweet pink, and cream palette
clothes/lisa_says_gah.context: Stylish San Francisco apartment, bookshop, or autumn street fragments with witty retro-modern styling.
clothes/lisa_says_gah.layout: Grounded retro editorial with checks, horses, stripes, knitwear, trousers, and skirts; colour is warm rather than candy-bright.
clothes/lisa_says_gah.duplicate_policy: Every print and garment type appears once; use no more than one large floral panel.

must_include: distinct geometric, botanical, animal, and abstract print families
emerald, navy, wine, ochre, and cream grounds
clothes/lisou.context: Refined London townhouse, gallery, or studio with crisp silk texture and controlled colour.
clothes/lisou.layout: Stylish print-led collage where each panel shows a different exclusive pattern and tailored silhouette.
clothes/lisou.duplicate_policy: No print family, colour ground, silhouette, or pose may repeat.

must_include: cognac, forest, navy, cream, cobalt, and red accents
clothes/longchamp.context: Contemporary Paris street and architectural studio with travel-informed polish and confident colour.
clothes/longchamp.layout: Everyday elegance through outerwear, knit, dress, skirt, and trouser silhouettes with rich texture and one bold colour.
clothes/longchamp.duplicate_policy: Each panel must introduce a distinct silhouette, texture, and colour family.

must_include: raw white, desert taupe, acorn, terracotta, olive, and soft blue
clothes/made_by_minga.context: Quiet Andean workshop, adobe wall, natural landscape, and tactile studio fragments focused on handwork.
clothes/made_by_minga.layout: Neutral artisanal knitwear and hats with visible wool, alpaca, crochet, weave, and restrained embroidery textures.
clothes/made_by_minga.duplicate_policy: No motif or knit technique repeats; natural neutrals must dominate with at most two soft accents.

clothes/mary_katrantzou.context: Geometric gallery or Mediterranean domestic-modernist setting with ceramics, glass, and graphic shadow used sparingly.
clothes/mary_katrantzou.layout: Seven distinct engineered print languages across dress, coat, trouser, skirt, blouse, and lace pieces.
clothes/mary_katrantzou.duplicate_policy: Every panel must use a visibly different pattern scale, motif family, colour ground, and garment.

must_include: tobacco, olive, faded blue, ecru, rust, and charcoal
clothes/masscob.context: Quiet Galician town, country house, or textured studio with natural light and understated romantic ease.
clothes/masscob.layout: Refined lived-in European wardrobe balancing tailoring, shirting, trousers, knitwear, outerwear, and one print dress.
clothes/masscob.duplicate_policy: Each panel must change garment family, material, colour, and silhouette.

must_include: pearl, noir, scarlet, butter, champagne, and soft pink
must_avoid: fantasy couture unrelated to current products
clothes/mirror_palais.context: Intimate New York apartment, old-world salon, garden, and clean studio fragments with cinematic romantic light.
clothes/mirror_palais.layout: Balance recognisable corsetry, minis, lady-length dresses, cowl shapes, and no more than two formal gowns.

must_include: retro feminine line mixed with oversized sport
light blue, red, yellow, brown, grey, and cream
clothes/miu_miu.context: Quirky Milan campus, runway, and candid street fragments with deliberate mismatch and youthful confidence.
clothes/miu_miu.layout: Playful mix-and-match collage contrasting preppy knitwear, technical sport, denim, checks, and feminine minis.
clothes/miu_miu.duplicate_policy: Every panel changes era cue, garment, colour, proportion, and styling combination.

must_include: bold blue or green graphic polo
gold, red, cobalt, green, and black accents
one provocative cut-out or latex-like piece
clothes/mowalola.context: London club, Lagos street, underground music, and flash-lit studio fragments with rebellious energy.
clothes/mowalola.layout: Sexy streetwear collision of bomber, track, polo, leather, fitted top, and colour-saturated graphic pieces.

must_include: one bold graphic or abstract print
black, red, cobalt, pink, chartreuse, and white

clothes/nili_lotan.context: Tribeca street, music studio, ranch-modern interior, and candid editorial fragments with lived-in polish.
clothes/nili_lotan.layout: Effortless 1970s rock, western, denim, suede, and tailoring mix with feminine ease.

must_include: earth tones with artichoke, coral, soft blue, and cream accents
clothes/nude_lucy.context: Modern Sydney architecture, coastal city street, and bright studio fragments with practical polished styling.
clothes/nude_lucy.layout: Interesting everyday wardrobe with coordinated separates, drape, tailoring, knit, linen, and soft seasonal colour.

must_include: one restrained logo or political-art tee
black, cream, red, blue, brown, and olive

clothes/opera_sport.context: Hip Copenhagen-Seoul street, gallery, and clean studio fragments mixing urban sport with refined romance.
clothes/opera_sport.layout: Modern asymmetric collage with seamless cotton, denim, lace, ruffle, tailoring, and sporty-elegant contrast.

clothes/patou.context: Graphic Paris studio and street with youthful couture proportion, clean colour, and witty polish.
clothes/patou.layout: Fresh modern Patou wardrobe led by volume, crisp cotton, short proportions, tailoring, and restrained colour blocking.
clothes/patou.duplicate_policy: Each panel must show a distinct proportion, garment family, colour, and construction detail.

must_include: black, mocha, cream, cobalt, wine, and restrained bright accents
clothes/rich_mnisi.context: Polished Johannesburg architecture, gallery, and runway fragments with contemporary luxury and strong silhouette.
clothes/rich_mnisi.layout: Sophisticated modern fashion collage balancing sculptural solids, tailoring, knitwear, and only two engineered prints.
clothes/rich_mnisi.duplicate_policy: Every panel changes print or solid treatment, silhouette, colour, and garment type.

must_include: black, dark red, brown, white, and muted blue
clothes/rotate_birger_christensen.context: Hip Copenhagen street, design hotel, and clean studio fragments with Scandi-glam attitude that works beyond parties.
clothes/rotate_birger_christensen.layout: Stylish day-to-night mix of knit, lace, leather, tailoring, one leopard accent, and no more than one sequin piece.
clothes/rotate_birger_christensen.duplicate_policy: Each panel must change occasion, silhouette, material, colour, and proportion.

must_include: very slim or deliberately oversized tailoring
clothes/celine.context: Parisian night, polished stone, mirrored studio, or stark backstage fragments.
clothes/celine.layout: High-contrast editorial crops with vertical rhythm and clean rectangular cuts.

must_avoid: plain black blouse as a hero
clothes/ganni.context: Colourful Copenhagen street or playful studio fragments.
clothes/ganni.layout: Irregular sticker-like cutouts and bold colour blocking.

clothes/praying.context: Flash-lit bedroom, internet-culture, or paparazzi-style fragments without readable text.
clothes/praying.layout: Messy-digital scrapbook rhythm with sharp cutouts; no repeated bean shapes.

bags/ami_paris.context: Polished Paris street or clean studio with warm neutral stone.
bags/ami_paris.layout: Structured rectangular and heart-echo cutouts, with one on-body scale reference.
bags/ami_paris.logo_policy: The heart clasp is an approved product identifier; no extra wordmark.

bags/arizona_love.context: Sun-bleached desert roadside, worn denim, and bandana-textile fragments.
bags/arizona_love.layout: Bandana-edge cutouts, stitched patches, and angular desert-colour panels.

bags/chopova_lowena.context: Backstage, punk club, or rough urban texture fragments.
bags/chopova_lowena.layout: Plaid-edged shards, hardware details, and energetic asymmetry.

bags/miu_miu.context: Glossy youth-culture editorial or playful dressing-room fragments.
bags/miu_miu.layout: Small polished panels, perforation-inspired dots, and one strong on-body image.
bags/miu_miu.logo_policy: One authentic product logo detail is allowed; no repeated wordmarks.

shoes/atoms.context: Minimal city walking and clean material-detail fragments.
shoes/atoms.layout: Soft geometric textile-inspired panels, not a rigid grid.

shoes/chanel.context: Tweed, polished salon, monochrome floor, or Paris street fragments used sparingly.
shoes/chanel.layout: Elegant layered cutouts with fine lines and textile edges.
shoes/chanel.logo_policy: A single authentic product mark may appear, but silhouette and material must do most of the recognition.

shoes/coperni.context: Futurist runway, reflective studio, or clean architectural fragments.
shoes/coperni.layout: Curved architectural slices and sharp reflective details.

jewellery/tory_burch.context: Polished lacquer, tailored fabric, and clean lifestyle fragments.
jewellery/tory_burch.layout: Symmetrical-but-lively panels with circular hardware echoes.
jewellery/tory_burch.logo_policy: The double-T motif is an approved product identifier; use once or twice only.

jewellery/valentino.context: Red lacquer, tailored eveningwear, or polished stone fragments used with restraint.
jewellery/valentino.layout: Crisp high-fashion crops with one strong red accent.
jewellery/valentino.logo_policy: A single V-logo product element is approved; no extra text.
